name: Example Weather Co
short: Example Weather Co: current temperature and rain readings from its own stations in Ohio.
summary: Fictional provider used as a template. Example Weather Co runs 40 weather stations in Ohio and serves the latest temperature, humidity and rainfall for each through a keyed JSON API. Replace every value with what your own public pages say.

pricing.notes: 0 means the price is not published, or the service is free; the note says which.

latency.notes: Docs page: stations report every 10 minutes; the API answers from the latest report.

delivery.basis: Docs page: stations report every 10 minutes.

coverage.notes: 40 stations; dense around Columbus and Cleveland, sparse in the south east.

licensing.summary: Terms page: free for any use with attribution. Training AI models on the data is not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: Sign up on the developer page; the key is shown at once.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; stations are unattended.

application.unknown: Nothing is stated about the station software.

camera.unknown: Not applicable to a temperature sensor; no signing is described.

time.unknown: Each reading has a timestamp from the station; how the clock is kept right is not stated.

location.unknown: Station coordinates are published; nothing proves a station has not been moved.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second sensor is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of the network is described.

sources.claim: 40 stations in Ohio, readings every 10 minutes, keyed JSON API
Free with attribution; resale not allowed
